esops.note: From the management console to every workstation.
esops.description: Coordinate SOP documents, production scheduling and employee reporting in one workspace.
esops.loginHint: Choose your tenant and sign in with your account.

home.headline: Bring work standards to every station.
home.intro: Connect SOP management, production scheduling, workstation execution and employee reporting in one workspace.
home.flowIntro: Select a stage to see how the console and workstations work together.
home.desc1: Maintain work documents and versions, review effective SOPs and associate instructions with products and operations.
home.desc2: Schedule production by order and operation, then publish instructions to lines and workstations.
home.desc3: Employees sign in on Android or Web terminals to view station tasks and work instructions.
home.desc4: Report good and defective quantities by operation so managers can follow production progress.
home.capDesc1: Organize SOPs by category, product and operation to help employees find the right instruction.
home.capDesc2: Connect workshops, production lines and stations with scheduled work.
home.capDesc3: View tasks and instructions and report production from dedicated Android devices or Web terminals.
home.ctaDesc: Create a company tenant and administrator account with email verification, or sign in to an existing account.
home.smsNotice: Verify your email address to create your company workspace.
home.registerHint: Enter company and administrator details, then verify your email to register.
home.smsPending: SMS verification is being activated. Code delivery and self-service registration are not yet available.
home.emailPending: Registration email service is not ready. Try later or contact the platform administrator.
home.emailSent: Code sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
home.registrationClosed: Public registration is currently closed. Contact the platform administrator.
